dock.search: Opens the document search palette. {{shortcut}} is a keyboard shortcut and stays verbatim
dock.tools: Product name of the utilities modal

colors.blue: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.cream: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.peach: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.rose: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.pink: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.lilac: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.sky: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.aqua: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.cyan: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.mint: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf
colors.spring: Cover colour of a project book on the shelf

home.resetFilters: Button that returns every advanced filter to its default

columns.type: Column header for the project kind: document, image or diagram, or external for a folder opened where it is on disk
columns.engine: Column header for the compiler a project uses

filters.bookmarkAll: Select option meaning the bookmark filter is off
filters.previewAll: Select option meaning the PDF preview filter is off
filters.previewYes: A compiled PDF exists for the project
filters.previewNo: No compiled PDF exists for the project
filters.location: Label of the filter that picks projects by where they live: inside the Oleafly library, or in folders opened in place on disk
filters.locationAll: Location filter option that shows projects from both places
filters.locationLibrary: Location filter option: projects stored inside the Oleafly library, as opposed to folders opened where they are on disk
filters.locationExternal: Location filter option: folders the user opened in place from anywhere on disk. Use the same word as the external project kind

projects.openToRecover: The project was interrupted mid restore and must be opened to finish recovery
projects.recoveryShort: Short badge for a project that needs recovery
projects.changeColor: Menu item that opens a submenu of cover colours for the project book

kind.document: Project kind, shown in lower case and capitalised by the style sheet
kind.image: Project kind, shown in lower case and capitalised by the style sheet
kind.diagram: Project kind, shown in lower case and capitalised by the style sheet
kind.external: Project kind for a folder opened where it is on disk instead of stored in the Oleafly library. Shown in lower case and capitalised by the style sheet, in the same place and style as document

exportsDialog.fallbackFormat: Shown when an exported file has no recorded format

menu.local: Menu heading for import sources on this computer
menu.cloud: Menu heading for import sources on the internet

picker.projectFilter: File type name in the native open dialog
picker.wordFilter: File type name in the native open dialog
picker.markdownFilter: File type name in the native open dialog

pdfImport.local: Badge saying the conversion runs on this computer, nothing is uploaded

views.preview: Shows the rendered pages of the source PDF
views.split: Shows pages and source side by side

generate.badge: Marks a template that an AI model produced
generate.saved: Button state after the template was saved, hovering it offers Unsave
generate.unsave: Removes a saved template from the library again

github.private: Repository visibility, not a person's privacy
github.trackedSecretsPrompt_one: Shown in the Publish to GitHub dialog before anything is created on GitHub. {{files}} is a list of project file paths such as .env and deploy/server.pem, already joined in the reader's language; the count is how many paths there are. Git history means every earlier commit of the project, which a push uploads as well.
github.trackedSecretsPrompt_other: Shown in the Publish to GitHub dialog before anything is created on GitHub. {{files}} is a list of project file paths such as .env and deploy/server.pem, already joined in the reader's language; the count is how many paths there are. Git history means every earlier commit of the project, which a push uploads as well.
github.publishAnyway: Button that continues publishing with the listed files in the upload. Keep it short.
github.leftOutSecrets_one: Shown after publishing. {{files}} is a list of project file paths, already joined in the reader's language; the count is how many paths there are. Source Control is the name of Oleafly's Git panel.
github.leftOutSecrets_other: Shown after publishing. {{files}} is a list of project file paths, already joined in the reader's language; the count is how many paths there are. Source Control is the name of Oleafly's Git panel.
github.moreFiles_one: Ends a shortened file list. {{files}} is the first five paths, already joined, and {{more}} is how many paths are not shown, already formatted; the count is the same number.
github.moreFiles_other: Ends a shortened file list. {{files}} is the first five paths, already joined, and {{more}} is how many paths are not shown, already formatted; the count is the same number.
github.nothingToPublish: Shown when every file in a project was left out, so the new GitHub repository stays empty.

deadlines.eyebrow: Small label above the page heading
deadlines.estimatedBadge: Short badge meaning the date is an estimate, keep it very short

urgency.comfortable: The deadline is far enough away that no warning is needed

deadlines.nextDeadline: {{kind}} is a deadline name from the dataset, such as Abstract or Submission, and stays verbatim

state.offline: The external or network drive that holds the folder is not connected
state.replaced: A different folder now sits at the saved path

menu.copyToLibrary: Menu item that copies an opened folder into a new project inside the Oleafly library
menu.remove: Forgets the folder in Oleafly without deleting any of its files

missing.body: <path> wraps the folder path, which is shown as a code-style badge. Keep the tag around {{path}}

offline.body: <path> wraps the folder path, which is shown as a code-style badge. Keep the tag around {{path}}

replaced.body: <path> wraps the folder path, which is shown as a code-style badge. Keep the tag around {{path}}

unavailable.locate: Button that opens a folder picker so the user can point Oleafly at the moved folder

permissionDenied.bodyMac: Path through macOS System Settings; use the names macOS shows in this language
permissionDenied.bodyOther: <path> wraps the folder path, which is shown as a code-style badge. Keep the tag around {{path}}

back.title: A folder that could not be reached a moment ago can be reached again
back.body: <path> wraps the folder path, which is shown as a code-style badge. Keep the tag around {{path}}

copy.count: Progress, for example 12 of 40 items or 1.2 MB of 3 MB
copy.doneLeftOut: Links are symbolic links pointing outside the folder; nested too deeply means past the folder depth Oleafly walks
